agro_products.name: Rice Abgina
agro_products.usage: Rice ko 2–3 dafa clean water se wash karein. 20–30 minutes ke liye soak karein, phir required quantity ke water ke saath pot ya rice cooker mein cook karein. Biryani, pulao aur daily meals ke liye suitable.

agro_products.name: Spry Pump
agro_products.details: Durable and efficient spray pump designed for spraying crops, fertilizers, pesticides, and water evenly.
agro_products.usage:
Tank fill karein: Pani ya recommended spray solution tank mein daalein.
Pump check karein: Hose aur nozzle properly connect karein.
Pressure banayein: Pump ko operate karke required pressure create karein.
Spray karein: Nozzle ko crop ki taraf rakh kar evenly spray karein.
Distance maintain karein: Crop ke hisaab se suitable distance rakhein.
After use: Tank, hose aur nozzle ko clean water se wash karein.
Safety: Pesticide/fertilizer spray karte waqt gloves, mask aur protective clothing use karein
